scientific_integrity: The stationary beta law and Gaussian convolution, and the equal-rate thermal transition, are prior literature; only the asymmetric threshold classification and explicit two-thirds cusp law are evaluated as new. Deterministic numerical checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Assumes two-state Markov propulsion with dimensionless positive rates below one, harmonic trapping, independent thermal white noise; near-symmetric cusp at fixed ell in (0,1). Relies on standard Gaussian variation-diminishing and parabolic zero-number theorem. Priority may be affected by unindexed studies.
title: A two-thirds-power thermal cusp for biased run-and-tumble motion in a harmonic trap
